- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in upward momentum phases.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is weak or negative; model reacts too slowly to bearish signals.
- Lag in correction: model often delays downward adjustments after price peaks, especially when sentiment is mixed or declining.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp moves, leading to premature reversal in trending periods.
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment is high (e.g., >0.6), model tends to overpredict; when sentiment is low (<0.4), model underpredicts.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are prone to overestimating volatility in early periods, especially if sentiment is rising.
- Avoid “sudden drop” after spike: model often fails to account for sharp reversals following strong upward moves, especially if sentiment shifts abruptly.
